context:
Keep fixture tests deterministic, but add a separate UAT smoke contract that
discovers ids from the generated external corpus. Validate the corpus before
browser launch so route failures point to UI behavior rather than missing data.
description:
The 2026-05-12 enabled-platform UAT `explorer_smoke` phase failed after the
Results Explorer build and fixture generation succeeded. `playwright_smoke.log`
shows 2/9 tests passed and 7 route assertions failed. The failed route tests
expected fixture-specific headings and facets such as DuckDB/TPC-H content,
while the corrected UAT artifact corpus only had clean LakeSail result bundles.

UAT Explorer smoke should prove the packaged external corpus can be loaded and
navigated. It should not fail merely because a coverage run does not contain
the same benchmark/platform ids as the frontend developer fixture corpus.

anti_patterns.dont: commit Playwright report directories, screenshots, or generated browser artifacts
hard-code DuckDB/TPC-H expectations into UAT external-corpus smoke
weaken route assertions to only test that the app shell loads

deferrals.reason: The UAT failure is smoke-test corpus coupling, not a product navigation redesign.
deferrals.resolved_reason: [G4 sweep] obsolete: Explicitly rejected: the UAT failure was smoke-test corpus coupling, not a navigation/route-hierarchy problem.

preserves.behavior: Developer fixture route tests still verify the known frontend fixture corpus
Playwright screenshots/reports remain outside git unless they are intentional docs assets
UAT external-corpus smoke validates real packaged result bundles from the UAT run

prior_art.concept: results-explorer/e2e/support/fixtures.ts -- fixture lookup helper used by failing route tests
tests/uat/phases/explorer_smoke.py -- UAT phase that builds fixtures and invokes Playwright smoke
tests/uat/test_explorer_smoke.py -- existing Python-side smoke phase coverage

verifications.command: uv run -- python -m pytest tests/uat/test_explorer_smoke.py -m fast -q
verifications.description: Python UAT Explorer smoke coverage passes
verifications.expected: passes with corpus-contract and dynamic-id smoke cases

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm run test:e2e:fixtures && npm run build && npx playwright test --grep @smoke --project chromium
verifications.description: Frontend fixture route tests still pass
verifications.expected: passes against the standard fixture corpus

verifications.description: External-corpus smoke passes against a UAT result directory
verifications.expected: Explorer smoke derives ids from the packaged corpus and passes without hard-coded DuckDB/TPC-H assumptions

work_units.notes:
Confirmed the failure mode was fixture coupling: the UAT smoke invoked
`--grep @smoke`, which selected route tests hard-coded to deterministic
DuckDB/TPC-H fixture ids instead of deriving ids from the packaged UAT
corpus. No screenshots, Playwright reports, or raw browser artifacts were
committed.
work_units.summary: Revalidate Explorer smoke failure against current UAT corpus

work_units.notes:
Added `results-explorer/e2e/smoke/external-corpus.spec.ts` under a
dedicated `@uat-external-corpus` tag. The test reads the mounted
`E2E_FIXTURE_DIR`, discovers benchmark/platform/result/query ids from
bundle JSON, and asserts those routes render. The developer fixture route
smoke remains under `@smoke`.
work_units.summary: Split fixed fixture route tests from external-corpus UAT smoke

work_units.notes:
`tests/uat/phases/explorer_smoke.py` now validates non-empty result
bundles and required `run`, `benchmark`, `scale_factor`, and `platform`
metadata before Playwright. It also resolves package roots to their
`bundle/` subdirectory so submission manifests are not treated as result
bundles.
work_units.summary: Add corpus-contract checks before launching Playwright

work_units.notes:
Updated `docs/operations/uat-framework.md` to document the
`@uat-external-corpus` UAT smoke, the per-run
`explorer_corpus_contract.json`, and the separate developer fixture
route command.
work_units.summary: Update UAT Explorer smoke docs and CI commands
